AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should you do after mopping a floor? (1 mark)
   A. Pour more water
   B. Put up a sign that the floor is wet
   C. Sweep it
   D. Run on it

2. Which waste should not be burnt because the smoke is harmful? (1 mark)
   A. Dry leaves
   B. Wood
   C. Paper
   D. Plastic

3. What should you wear when handling rubbish? (1 mark)
   A. Gloves
   B. Nothing
   C. Sandals only
   D. Only a hat

4. Why should you never mix cleaning chemicals? (1 mark)
   A. They can give off harmful fumes
   B. They will cost more
   C. They will look nicer
   D. They become soap

5. How should an overall be cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Wipe it with a dry cloth only
   B. Wash with soap, rinse and dry in the sun
   C. Burn it
   D. Leave it wet

6. Which PPE keeps dust from being breathed in? (1 mark)
   A. Gumboots
   B. Headgear
   C. Dust mask
   D. Overall

7. What should you do with cleaning materials afterwards? (1 mark)
   A. Store them away from small children
   B. Give to animals
   C. Leave them on the floor
   D. Drink them

8. Which PPE protects the hands? (1 mark)
   A. Gloves
   B. Dust mask
   C. Gumboots
   D. Headgear

9. Why stuff canvas shoes with paper after washing? (1 mark)
   A. It makes them wet
   B. It makes them dirty
   C. It keeps their shape and soaks up moisture
   D. It makes them heavier

10. Which is a correct step for cleaning gloves? (1 mark)
   A. Put them on again dirty
   B. Wear them wet
   C. Pull them off from the wrist so the dirty outside does not touch skin
   D. Snatch them off by the fingers

11. How long should a length of thread be for tacking? (1 mark)
   A. 10 metres
   B. About as long as from fingertips to elbow, up to 50 cm
   C. 1 cm
   D. As long as the room

12. Which is a mistake in tacking? (1 mark)
   A. Making stitches of different lengths in even tacking
   B. Marking the line first
   C. Using contrasting thread
   D. Using small back stitch at the end

13. What is a tacking stitch? (1 mark)
   A. A temporary stitch that holds cloth in place
   B. A cutting tool
   C. A permanent decorative stitch
   D. A type of cloth

14. When is long and short tacking a good choice? (1 mark)
   A. It is never used
   B. For long straight seams where a quick hold is enough
   C. For hems on very slippery cloth
   D. For curves only

15. What is a pin cushion used for? (1 mark)
   A. Ironing cloth
   B. Keeping needles and pins safe
   C. Cutting cloth
   D. Measuring cloth

16. Which item can be made with tacking stitches in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A handkerchief
   B. A roof
   C. A car
   D. A house

17. Which tool holds a needle safely on the finger to push it? (1 mark)
   A. Pin cushion
   B. Ruler
   C. Thimble
   D. Scissors

18. Why should you tie a knot in the thread before tacking? (1 mark)
   A. To make the thread thicker
   B. So that the thread stays in the cloth
   C. So the needle does not move
   D. To make the cloth stiffer

19. Which skill from Mathematics helps in tacking? (1 mark)
   A. Adding money
   B. Naming shapes only
   C. Measuring
   D. Telling time

20. About how long is each stitch in even tacking in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. 10 cm
   B. 1 mm
   C. 1 metre
   D. 1 cm

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how stagnant water around the home can lead to disease and how to prevent it. (4 marks)

22. Plan a class display of cleaned PPE. Say what you would show and what information cards you would write. (5 marks)

23. List the tools and materials needed for tacking. (3 marks)

24. Describe how to make even tacking. (4 marks)

25. What is personal protective equipment (PPE)? (2 marks)

26. Name two types of tacking stitches and describe each. (3 marks)

27. Give three reasons why PPE should be cleaned. (3 marks)

28. Explain why tacking thread should be loose. (2 marks)

29. What are tacking stitches? (2 marks)

30. Why should gumboots not be dried near a hot fire? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Put up a sign that the floor is wet
   Wet floors are slippery.

2. D — Plastic
   Burning plastics gives harmful smoke.

3. A — Gloves
   Gloves protect from germs and cuts.

4. A — They can give off harmful fumes
   Mixing chemicals is dangerous.

5. B — Wash with soap, rinse and dry in the sun
   Sunshine helps to kill germs.

6. C — Dust mask
   A mask covers the nose and mouth.

7. A — Store them away from small children
   Keep them safe.

8. A — Gloves
   Gloves cover the hands.

9. C — It keeps their shape and soaks up moisture
   Paper absorbs water.

10. C — Pull them off from the wrist so the dirty outside does not touch skin
   This prevents germs touching the skin.

11. B — About as long as from fingertips to elbow, up to 50 cm
   Long thread tangles.

12. A — Making stitches of different lengths in even tacking
   Stitches should be equal.

13. A — A temporary stitch that holds cloth in place
   Tacking is removed later.

14. B — For long straight seams where a quick hold is enough
   It is quicker.

15. B — Keeping needles and pins safe
   It holds sharp objects.

16. A — A handkerchief
   A handkerchief is an easy first item.

17. C — Thimble
   A thimble protects the finger.

18. B — So that the thread stays in the cloth
   A knot stops the thread pulling through.

19. C — Measuring
   Measuring gives even and accurate stitches.

20. D — 1 cm
   Even tacking uses 1 cm stitches and gaps.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mosquitoes breed in it and spread malaria. Empty tins and tyres, fill puddles, and drain water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breeding, 1 mark for disease, 2 marks for prevention.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: Display gloves, gumboots, mask, headgear, overall, canvas shoes; cards say what each protects and how to clean it; safe storage; explain to visitors.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for items, 2 marks for cards, 1 mark for explaining.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Needle, thread, scissors, ruler or tape measure, chalk, pins, cloth, thimble (any correct materials).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each, up to 3.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mark a line; bring the needle up; make 1 cm stitches with 1 cm gaps along the line; keep the thread loose; finish with a small back stitch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Clothing and gear worn to protect the body from dirt, injury, dust and germs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for clothing or gear, 1 mark for protection.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Even tacking has equal stitches and gaps; long and short tacking has a long stitch followed by a short stitch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name and 1 for correct descriptions.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: It can carry germs, it may smell or spoil, and clean PPE lasts longer and protects better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight thread pulls and wrinkles the cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pulls, 1 mark for wrinkles.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Large, loose temporary stitches used to hold cloth in place before permanent sewing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for temporary, 1 mark for holding cloth.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heat can crack the rubber and spoil the boots.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for heat, 1 mark for cracking.
